newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Seng won't be hit by U.S. rate rises.
newsitem.headline: Hang Seng won't be hit by U.S. rate rises.

text.p: Hang Seng Bank Ltd said on Tuesday that any U.S. interest rate rises this year would not have much impact on the bank.

Alexander Au, vice-chairmn and chief executive, told a news conference an expected rise of a total 75 basis point in U.S. interest rates this year should not greatly affect loan demand but would lead to a rise in interest income.
Au said he could not see how the 25 basis point increase already implemented could negatively affect loan demand or have a big impact on Hong Kong's economy.
Hong Kong interest rates usually follow the direction of their U.S. counterparts because the Hong Kong currency is pegged to the U.S. dollar.
